license.q: Do I need an international driving license?
license.a: No. A valid licence from your home country is accepted in North Cyprus for stays under 90 days.

ercan.q: Can I be picked up at Ercan Airport?
ercan.a: Yes. Most companies offer free pickup at Ercan. Larnaca pickup is usually available with a transfer fee.

cancel.a: Most bookings can be cancelled free of charge up to 24 hours before pickup.

documents.q: What documents do I bring on pickup day?
documents.a: Your passport, your driving licence, and a credit card in the driver's name for the deposit.

insurance.q: Is insurance included in the price?
insurance.a: Basic third-party insurance is always included. Full coverage (CDW + theft, no excess) is available as an extra at checkout.

home.ctaTitle: Run a rental company in North Cyprus?
home.ctaSubtitle: Reach travellers landing at Ercan and Larnaca every day. No setup fees, only commission on confirmed bookings.

about.title: About Renarvo
about.body: Renarvo connects travellers visiting North Cyprus with local, licensed rental companies — from family-run agencies in Girne to large fleets at Ercan Airport. We started in 2024 because booking a car in KKTC still meant phone calls, WhatsApp messages and price guessing. We changed that.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.body: Tell us where you're landing (Ercan, Larnaca or anywhere on the island), pick your dates, and compare cars from real local companies. Pay online or on pickup, cancel free up to 24 hours before. The company you book with — not Renarvo — hands you the keys.

forCompanies.title: For rental companies
forCompanies.body: If you operate a rental fleet anywhere from Lefkoşa to Karpaz, list it on Renarvo. No setup fee. You only pay commission on confirmed bookings. We handle the website, payments, and multilingual customer support; you keep your fleet on the road.

help.title: Help center
help.body: Need a hand with a booking, a refund, or a license question for KKTC? Search our knowledge base or message our team — we reply in Turkish, English and Russian.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.body: Renarvo Ltd · Girne, North Cyprus · hello@renarvo.com · +90 533 000 00 00. We reply within one business day.

terms.title: Terms of service
terms.body: By using Renarvo you agree to these terms. Bookings are contracts between you and the rental company you choose. Renarvo facilitates the booking and payment but is not the vehicle operator. Full text available on request.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.body: We collect only what's needed to confirm your booking and we don't sell your data. Driver license details are shared with the rental company you book with, and nobody else. Full policy on request.
